observations: Large multi-function printer with a touchscreen control panel.
Brand 'Konica Minolta' and model 'bizhub PRO C754e' are printed on the front of the machine.
The machine is located in an outdoor or semi-outdoor environment with other printers visible.
The top scanner glass is covered with plastic wrap.
The machine appears to be in a used or commercial setting.

claims.claim: large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer
Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or print.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on and printing a test page.

risks.risk: The internal components (drum and toner) may be empty or degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum units with their labels visible.

risks.risk: The machine may have a high error count or mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the machine's status screen showing the error code and page count.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner and drum units to confirm quantity and condition.
Screenshot of the machine's status screen showing the page count and error code.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
